body:
Real root cause for the broken Ctrl+Alt+S hotkey: SDL_StartTextInput() active on this screen, and Ctrl+Alt is literal AltGr on Windows -- a held Ctrl+Alt+letter can be consumed by OS/IME as a dead-key sequence, so the KEYDOWN never fires with both modifiers. Two real, visible, clickable buttons added (LOG IN, SIGN UP), old hotkey/Enter kept working underneath. Full WASM build clean, commit 1e1c39a, redeployed and live-verified all 4 real artifacts.

⚓ ☃
title: GFD-FIX + GFD-UX-8325432 shipped: real LOG IN/SIGN UP buttons (closes both cards, same real fix)
